metadata.description: Lauren Tan's pstack skills and Cursor's make-pr-easy-to-review, ported to Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and other Agent Skills harnesses

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Find what a change could break outside the diff, and prove the one fact it's safe because of by running real code

plugins.name: bro
plugins.description: Restate the last message in plain human language, with no jargon

plugins.name: correct
plugins.description: Find the mistakes agents keep repeating in a repo and make each one impossible with architecture, types, lints, or tests

plugins.name: create-verification-skill
plugins.description: Generate a project-local skill that drives your app the way a user does and captures proof

plugins.name: figure-it-out
plugins.description: Design an auditable playbook for a large or ambiguous change, run it as a hypothesis loop, and log every decision

plugins.name: how
plugins.description: Explain how a subsystem works with parallel explorers and one architectural explanation

plugins.name: in-your-own-words
plugins.description: Restate what you think the user's goals are and what problem they're solving

plugins.name: interrogate
plugins.description: Adversarial multi-model code review that ends in a judged verdict, not auto-applied changes

plugins.name: ketchup
plugins.description: Catch the user up on what changed since their last message and list every call waiting on them

plugins.name: make-pr-easy-to-review
plugins.description: Make a PR easy to review: clean up noisy commits, rewrite the description, and add reviewer guidance without changing code behavior

plugins.name: no-comments
plugins.description: Run Comment Sicko over a diff, fix accepted findings, and encode claimed constraints instead of commenting them

plugins.name: sharpen
plugins.description: Sharpen a task before starting: the expert approach, the real goal, and the right level of specification

plugins.name: show-me-your-work
plugins.description: Keep a reviewable TSV decision trail for long-running or unattended work, audited and cross-reviewed

plugins.name: teach
plugins.description: Explain a body of work plainly by combining the how and why skills into one paced explanation

plugins.name: technical-writing
plugins.description: Layered technical-writing standard: Diataxis, Google developer style, STE, and Global English

plugins.name: unslop
plugins.description: Cut AI tells from any writing

plugins.name: why
plugins.description: Investigate why code is shaped the way it is across git, tickets, docs, chat, and telemetry, with calibrated confidence
